Political Science: National Politics and Governance

Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam

← Back to search
About this programme

A reliable curriculum comparison is currently unavailable. The external curriculum has unresolved requirements; no complete degree pathway is certified here.

VU National Politics and Government studies how political power and public administration work in the Netherlands. Students examine democracy, the welfare state, Europe, economics and political theory, and learn quantitative and qualitative research alongside writing and debate.

A complete comparison is awaiting verified curriculum information for students entering the new curriculum from 2025–2026. The confirmed subset below contains 120 EC across the first two years and at least 30 EC of open study. The third-year course credits and thesis allocation need confirmation, so no UCR alternative is presented. This does not establish that a UCR response is impossible.

Academic year: 2026–2027

Verified subset: 150 of 180 EC. Each Social Science for Society row represents one restricted 6 EC selection. The OER labels its 6/6/18 EC third-year table for the older cohort; the prospectus names the later courses without confirming that allocation for new entrants. Dutch language testing gates Academic Skills 1; thesis-entry, attendance and open-study approval rules apply.
